blocks.source: ワイルドアームズAF
blocks.translation: Wild Arms AF

blocks.source: この作品はＰＳ版の初代ワイルドアームズ（以下ＷＡ）のリメイクに当たるが、筆者はＰＳ版未プレイ。発売時期としては、ＷＡ３よりも後発だそうで。
blocks.translation: This game is a remake of the original PlayStation version of Wild Arms (hereafter WA), but I have not played the PlayStation version. Apparently, it was released after WA3.

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Mass / Story

blocks.source: ＰＳ版と比較して、新たに３人のキャラクターが仲間になるなどの要素が追加された。しかし、３人とも終盤になるまで、正式加入はしないのが残念。このシリーズ恒例で、クリア後にもラスボスより強い敵がたくさんいたりする。
blocks.translation: Compared to the PlayStation version, new elements were added, including three new characters who can join the party. Unfortunately, none of the three officially joins until near the end of the game. As is customary for this series, there are also many enemies stronger than the final boss waiting after the game is cleared.

blocks.source: 物語は人間と魔族の対立など、正に王道ＲＰＧといった内容。世界観やストーリーはしっかりと作りこまれている。ＷＡ３はエンディングが呆気なくて残念だったが、こちらは中々、エンディングにも力が入っている。
blocks.translation: The story, involving such themes as the conflict between humans and demons, is a quintessential classic RPG tale. The world and story have been carefully developed. WA3's ending was disappointingly anticlimactic, but this game puts considerably more effort into its ending.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Comfort

blocks.source: この作品には、大抵のＲＰＧにある『装備システム』（ＰＳ版にはあったらしい）が存在せず、代わりに『武器の改造』『スキルの装備』などのシステムがある。
blocks.translation: This game lacks the “equipment system” found in most RPGs (apparently, it was included in the PlayStation version), replacing it with systems such as “weapon customization” and “skill equipment.”

blocks.source: しかし、ＷＡ３と違って『武器の改造』ができるのは一部キャラだけ。『スキルの装備』も属性耐性・異常耐性などが中心と地味。基本的にはキャラの強化はレベルアップ中心となり、リメイク前と比べても、システム面では地味になった模様。
blocks.translation: However, unlike in WA3, only certain characters can customize their weapons. Skill equipment is also rather underwhelming, focusing mainly on elemental and status ailment resistance. Character enhancement is basically centered on leveling up, so compared to the original, the systems seem to have become less distinctive.

blocks.source: 戦闘システムは基本的には普通のターン制。可もなく不可もなくといったところ。
blocks.translation: The battle system is basically a standard turn-based system. It is neither particularly good nor bad.

blocks.source: ボスの強さなどは、強くもなく弱くもなく良好。ＷＡ３の用に簡単すぎたりはしない。ＷＡ２の用に通常攻撃だけの１ターンで雑魚戦が終わるようなこともあまりない。
blocks.translation: The boss difficulty is well balanced—not too hard and not too easy. It is not as easy as WA3. Nor do random battles usually end in a single turn with nothing but normal attacks, as they did in WA2.

blocks.source: ただ、気になったところも。
blocks.translation: There were, however, a few things that bothered me.

blocks.source: この作品のほとんどの期間はロディ、ザック、セシリアの ３人パーティで進む。しかし、ロディ、セシリアの反応（いわゆる素早さ）が低く、敵より先に動けるのがザックだけになりがち。どうしても、撃ち漏らした敵の攻撃を受けることが多く、そこが微妙なストレスになる。ＷＡ３では、反応の高い２人でザコ敵を攻撃前に片付けることができたので、比較すると結構気になる。
blocks.translation: For most of the game, you progress with a three-person party consisting of Rudy, Jack, and Cecilia. However, Rudy and Cecilia have low reaction (i.e., Agility), so Jack is often the only one who can act before the enemies. As a result, you frequently end up taking attacks from enemies you failed to defeat, which becomes a minor source of frustration. In WA3, two characters with high reaction could eliminate random enemies before they attacked, so this is fairly noticeable by comparison.

blocks.source: なお、ＰＳ版では最強だったらしいザックだが、今作では技の消費の割りにＭＰが低く、扱い辛いキャラとなっている。３人パーティの内の一人なんだから、もうちょっと使いやすくてもいいのに。
blocks.translation: Jack was apparently the strongest character in the PlayStation version, but in this game, his MP is low compared to the cost of his techniques, making him difficult to use. Since he is one of the three members of the party, I wish he had been a little easier to use.

blocks.source: 魔法やガーディアンなどの戦闘アニメ演出がＷＡ３よりも短くなったことは評価したいけれど、ザックやロディの特技を発動する際に、妙な間（ロード時間？）があるのが気になる。上記のバランスの問題もあって、総合的な戦闘テンポはＷＡ３に劣る。
blocks.translation: I appreciate that the battle animation effects for things like magic and Guardians are shorter than in WA3, but the odd pauses (loading times?) when activating Jack's or Rudy's Techs are distracting. Combined with the balance issues mentioned above, the overall battle pacing is inferior to WA3.

blocks.source: このゲームの最大の不満点はエンカウント周り。このシリーズにしてはエンカウント率が高い。また『不意打ち』『ピンチ』『バックアタック』などで、敵の先制攻撃を一方的に受けることが多く、ストレスが溜まる。どうもエンカウントを回避していると、不意打ちを受けやすいとのこと。快適にプレイさせるためのはずの要素にそんな不快な要素をつけられましても……。
blocks.translation: The biggest issue with this game is its encounter system. The encounter rate is high for this series. In addition, enemies often get the first attack through effects such as “Surprise Attack,” “Pinch,” and “Back Attack,” leaving you unable to do anything about it and building up frustration. Apparently, avoiding encounters makes you more likely to be surprised. Even if these features are supposed to make the game more comfortable to play, adding such unpleasant elements to them doesn’t help…

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Visuals

blocks.source: 味のあったＷＡ３から一転、ずいぶんとキャラクター造形が変わっている。正直、先発のＷＡ３のほうが綺麗に見えるような……。ヒロインのセシリアが一部で綺麗なジャイアン扱いされる始末。いえさすがに、そこまで酷くないと思いますよ。たぶん……。
blocks.translation: Compared to the distinctive style of WA3, the character designs have changed considerably. Honestly, the earlier WA3 looks prettier to me…… The heroine Cecilia even ended up being treated by some people as a “pretty Gian.” No, I don't think she is quite that bad. Probably……

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 音楽はリメイク前と同じ、なるけみちこ氏。元々、評判の良かったＰＳ版の曲をアレンジ。新曲も多く追加された。
blocks.translation: The music is by the same composer as before the remake, Michiko Naruke. The well-regarded songs from the PlayStation version were rearranged, and many new songs were added.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Summary

blocks.source: このシリーズのウリはダンジョンの謎解きや、ストーリーにある。しかし、戦闘システム・成長システムの練り込みは作品の規模を考えると物足りない印象を受ける。総合的にはリメイク前の方が、評判が良さ気なのが悲しいところ。
blocks.translation: The highlights of this series are its dungeon puzzles and story. However, considering the scale of the game, the battle and character-development systems feel insufficiently developed. Overall, it is sad that the original seems to have been better received than the remake.
